en_def: to leave your bed after sleeping; to stand up
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I woke up at 6' when they mean they left the bed. 'Wake up' = eyes open; 'get up' = leave the bed.

examples.en: I get up at six every morning.
examples.hi: मैं हर सुबह छह बजे उठता हूँ।

examples.en: She got up late and missed the bus.
examples.hi: वह देर से उठी और बस छूट गई।

examples.en: Get up, we're going to be late!
examples.hi: उठो, हमें देर हो जाएगी!

examples.en: He got up from his chair to greet us.
examples.hi: वह हमारा स्वागत करने के लिए अपनी कुर्सी से उठा।

examples.en: What time do you usually get up on Sundays?
examples.hi: रविवार को आप आमतौर पर कितने बजे उठते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: I get up from bed at 7 and then I wake up.
common_mistake.right: I wake up at 7 and then I get up.
common_mistake.why: 'Wake up' happens first (you open your eyes); 'get up' means leaving the bed.

cloze.sentence: I usually ____ at seven and have breakfast at half past.

en_def: to stop sleeping; to make someone stop sleeping
hi_nuance: Hindi 'जगाना' (cause to wake) is also 'wake somebody up' — it is separable: 'wake me up', never 'wake up me'.

examples.en: I woke up at five because of the noise.
examples.hi: शोर की वजह से मैं पाँच बजे जाग गया।

examples.en: Please wake me up at seven.
examples.hi: कृपया मुझे सात बजे जगा देना।

examples.en: The baby wakes up three times a night.
examples.hi: बच्चा रात में तीन बार जागता है।

examples.en: Don't wake up the kids; they just fell asleep.
examples.hi: बच्चों को मत जगाओ, वे अभी-अभी सोए हैं।

examples.en: She woke up feeling refreshed after the long sleep.
examples.hi: लंबी नींद के बाद वह तरोताज़ा महसूस करते हुए जागी।

collocations: wake up to the sound of

common_mistake.wrong: Please wake up me at 6.
common_mistake.right: Please wake me up at 6.
common_mistake.why: With a pronoun object, separable phrasal verbs must be split: wake + me + up.

cloze.sentence: Can you ____ me ____ before the meeting starts?

en_def: to start a machine, light, or device working
hi_nuance: Indian English often uses 'on the light' or 'open the light' (from Hindi 'लाइट खोलो'). Natural English is 'turn on the light' / 'switch on the light'.

examples.en: Could you turn on the light, please?
examples.hi: क्या आप लाइट चालू कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: Turn it on and wait for the update to install.
examples.hi: इसे चालू करो और अपडेट इंस्टॉल होने का इंतज़ार करो।

examples.en: I turned on the TV to watch the news.
examples.hi: मैंने समाचार देखने के लिए टीवी चालू किया।

examples.en: She turned the heater on because it was cold.
examples.hi: ठंड होने की वजह से उसने हीटर चालू किया।

examples.en: The server turns on automatically after a power cut.
examples.hi: बिजली जाने के बाद सर्वर अपने आप चालू हो जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please on the fan, it's hot.
common_mistake.right: Please turn on the fan, it's hot.
common_mistake.why: 'On' is not a verb in English; you need 'turn on' or 'switch on'.

cloze.sentence: It's dark in here — could you ____ the lights?

en_def: to stop a machine, light, or device working
hi_nuance: Hindi 'लाइट बंद करो' becomes 'close the light' in Indian English. Use 'turn off' / 'switch off'; 'close' is for doors and windows.

examples.en: Turn off the lights when you leave.
examples.hi: जाते समय लाइटें बंद कर देना।

examples.en: I forgot to turn my phone off during the movie.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म के दौरान मैं अपना फ़ोन बंद करना भूल गया।

examples.en: Turn it off and on again — that usually fixes it.
examples.hi: इसे बंद करके फिर चालू करो — आमतौर पर इससे ठीक हो जाता है।

examples.en: She turned off the tap to save water.
examples.hi: पानी बचाने के लिए उसने नल बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: Please turn off notifications during the demo.
examples.hi: डेमो के दौरान कृपया नोटिफ़िकेशन बंद कर दें।

common_mistake.wrong: Close the AC before you go.
common_mistake.right: Turn off the AC before you go.
common_mistake.why: You close doors and windows; you turn off machines and devices.

cloze.sentence: Don't forget to ____ the gas after cooking.

en_def: to lift something; to collect someone or something; to learn something without effort
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often use 'take' or 'collect' for people ('I will take you from the airport'). English says 'pick you up'. It has many meanings — lift, collect, learn, answer the phone.

examples.en: Can you pick up the kids from school today?
examples.hi: क्या आज तुम बच्चों को स्कूल से ले सकते हो?

examples.en: I'll pick you up at eight.
examples.hi: मैं तुम्हें आठ बजे लेने आऊँगा।

examples.en: He picked up the phone on the first ring.
examples.hi: उसने पहली घंटी पर ही फ़ोन उठा लिया।

examples.en: She picked up Spanish while living in Madrid.
examples.hi: मैड्रिड में रहते हुए उसने स्पेनिश सीख ली।

examples.en: Pick up your bag; we're leaving.
examples.hi: अपना बैग उठाओ; हम निकल रहे हैं।

examples.en: I need to pick up some milk on the way home.
examples.hi: मुझे घर जाते समय थोड़ा दूध लेना है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will come to take you from the station.
common_mistake.right: I'll pick you up from the station.
common_mistake.why: 'Take' sounds like removing someone; the natural verb for collecting a person is 'pick up'.

cloze.sentence: Could you ____ ____ my parcel from the post office?

en_def: to stop trying; to stop doing something you did regularly
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often write 'leave smoking' (from 'छोड़ना'). English: 'give up smoking' or 'quit smoking'. After 'give up' use the -ing form, not 'to'.

examples.en: Don't give up — you're almost there.
examples.hi: हार मत मानो — तुम लगभग पहुँच गए हो।

examples.en: He gave up smoking two years ago.
examples.hi: उसने दो साल पहले धूम्रपान छोड़ दिया।

examples.en: I gave up trying to fix the old laptop.
examples.hi: मैंने पुराना लैपटॉप ठीक करने की कोशिश छोड़ दी।

examples.en: She gave it up after one lesson.
examples.hi: उसने एक क्लास के बाद ही इसे छोड़ दिया।

examples.en: We gave up our seats for the elderly couple.
examples.hi: हमने बुज़ुर्ग जोड़े के लिए अपनी सीटें छोड़ दीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave up to eat sugar.
common_mistake.right: I gave up eating sugar.
common_mistake.why: 'Give up' is followed by a noun or an -ing form, never 'to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: After three failed attempts, he decided to ____ ____.

en_def: to try to find something or someone
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'search the keys' or 'I am searching for job'. Use 'look for' (with 'for') and remember 'a job' needs an article.

examples.en: I'm looking for my keys — have you seen them?
examples.hi: मैं अपनी चाबियाँ ढूँढ रहा हूँ — क्या तुमने देखी हैं?

examples.en: She is looking for a new job in Bangalore.
examples.hi: वह बैंगलोर में नई नौकरी ढूँढ रही है।

examples.en: We looked for a parking space for twenty minutes.
examples.hi: हमने बीस मिनट तक पार्किंग की जगह ढूँढी।

examples.en: What exactly are you looking for?
examples.hi: आप वास्तव में क्या ढूँढ रहे हैं?

examples.en: They're looking for someone with security experience.
examples.hi: वे सुरक्षा अनुभव वाले किसी व्यक्ति की तलाश कर रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am looking job.
common_mistake.right: I am looking for a job.
common_mistake.why: 'Look for' needs 'for', and singular countable 'job' needs 'a'.

cloze.sentence: Are you still ____ ____ a flat near the office?

en_def: to take care of someone or something
hi_nuance: Inseparable: 'look after her', never 'look her after'. Indian English often uses 'take care' alone; 'look after' is the everyday British form.

examples.en: Who will look after the dog while you're away?
examples.hi: जब तुम बाहर होगे तो कुत्ते की देखभाल कौन करेगा?

examples.en: She looks after her elderly parents.
examples.hi: वह अपने बुज़ुर्ग माता-पिता की देखभाल करती है।

examples.en: Look after yourself — don't work too hard.
examples.hi: अपना ख़्याल रखना — बहुत ज़्यादा काम मत करना।

examples.en: The nurse looked after him for three weeks.
examples.hi: नर्स ने तीन हफ़्ते तक उसकी देखभाल की।

examples.en: Our team looks after the payment servers.
examples.hi: हमारी टीम पेमेंट सर्वरों की देखभाल करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Can you look the baby after for an hour?
common_mistake.right: Can you look after the baby for an hour?
common_mistake.why: 'Look after' is inseparable; the object always comes after 'after'.

cloze.sentence: My neighbour will ____ ____ the plants while we're on holiday.

en_def: to search for information in a book, list, or online
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers tend to say 'search the meaning'. Natural English: 'look up the word' or 'look it up'. Separable.

examples.en: I looked up the word in the dictionary.
examples.hi: मैंने शब्दकोश में वह शब्द देखा।

examples.en: If you don't know the CVE, look it up.
examples.hi: अगर तुम्हें CVE नहीं पता, तो उसे खोज लो।

examples.en: Let me look up the train times.
examples.hi: मुझे ट्रेन का समय देखने दो।

examples.en: She looked up his number and called him.
examples.hi: उसने उसका नंबर खोजा और उसे फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: You can look up any IP address on that site.
examples.hi: आप उस साइट पर कोई भी IP पता देख सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I searched the word meaning in Google.
common_mistake.right: I looked up the word on Google.
common_mistake.why: 'Look up' is the natural verb for checking information, and it's 'on Google', not 'in Google'.

cloze.sentence: I didn't know the answer, so I ____ it ____.

en_def: to discover a fact or piece of information
hi_nuance: Hindi 'पता करना' is often translated as 'know' ('I will know and tell you'). Use 'find out' for discovering; 'know' is a state, not an action.

examples.en: I need to find out when the meeting starts.
examples.hi: मुझे पता लगाना है कि मीटिंग कब शुरू होती है।

examples.en: She found out that the email was a phishing attempt.
examples.hi: उसे पता चला कि वह ईमेल फ़िशिंग की कोशिश थी।

examples.en: How did you find out about the job?
examples.hi: तुम्हें नौकरी के बारे में कैसे पता चला?

examples.en: We'll find out the results tomorrow.
examples.hi: हमें कल नतीजे पता चलेंगे।

examples.en: Let me find out and get back to you.
examples.hi: मुझे पता करने दो, फिर मैं तुम्हें बताता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I will know the price and tell you.
common_mistake.right: I'll find out the price and tell you.
common_mistake.why: 'Know' describes a state; the action of discovering information is 'find out'.

cloze.sentence: Did you ever ____ ____ who sent that message?

en_def: to understand or solve something after thinking about it
hi_nuance: Indian English often uses 'understand' for everything. 'Figure out' means working it out through effort — great for debugging contexts.

examples.en: I can't figure out why the script keeps crashing.
examples.hi: मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा कि स्क्रिप्ट बार-बार क्रैश क्यों हो रही है।

examples.en: We finally figured out the root cause.
examples.hi: आख़िरकार हमने मूल कारण समझ लिया।

examples.en: Let me figure it out on my own first.
examples.hi: पहले मुझे इसे ख़ुद समझने दो।

examples.en: She figured out how to bypass the filter in ten minutes.
examples.hi: उसने दस मिनट में समझ लिया कि फ़िल्टर को कैसे बायपास किया जाए।

examples.en: Have you figured out what you want to do next year?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने तय कर लिया है कि अगले साल क्या करना है?

common_mistake.wrong: I could not figure out it.
common_mistake.right: I couldn't figure it out.
common_mistake.why: Pronoun objects go between the verb and the particle in separable phrasal verbs.

cloze.sentence: It took me an hour to ____ ____ the error.

en_def: to delay something until a later time
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'postpone' in speech, which sounds formal. 'Put off' is the everyday form. And 'prepone' does not exist — use 'bring forward'.

examples.en: We've put off the release until Monday.
examples.hi: हमने रिलीज़ सोमवार तक टाल दी है।

examples.en: Stop putting it off and call the dentist.
examples.hi: इसे टालना बंद करो और डेंटिस्ट को फ़ोन करो।

examples.en: They put off the meeting because the CTO was ill.
examples.hi: CTO के बीमार होने के कारण उन्होंने मीटिंग टाल दी।

examples.en: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
examples.hi: जो आज कर सकते हो उसे कल पर मत टालो।

examples.en: The bad reviews put me off buying that phone.
examples.hi: बुरे रिव्यू की वजह से मैंने वह फ़ोन ख़रीदने का इरादा छोड़ दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's prepone the call to 3 pm.
common_mistake.right: Let's bring the call forward to 3 pm.
common_mistake.why: 'Prepone' is Indian English only; the opposite of 'put off' is 'bring forward' or 'move up'.

cloze.sentence: I can't ____ this ____ any longer — the deadline is Friday.

en_def: to arrange, start, or install something so that it is ready to use
hi_def: स्थापित करना, सेट करना, व्यवस्था करना
hi_nuance: The noun is 'setup' (one word); the verb is 'set up' (two words). Indian English overuses 'arrange a meeting' — 'set up a meeting' is more natural at work.

examples.en: Can you set up a call with the client for Thursday?
examples.hi: क्या तुम गुरुवार को क्लाइंट के साथ कॉल सेट कर सकते हो?

examples.en: I set up the test environment this morning.
examples.hi: मैंने आज सुबह टेस्ट एनवायरनमेंट सेट किया।

examples.en: They set up a company in 2019.
examples.hi: उन्होंने 2019 में एक कंपनी शुरू की।

examples.en: Set it up and let me know when it's ready.
examples.hi: इसे सेट करो और तैयार होने पर मुझे बताना।

examples.en: We need to set up two-factor authentication for all accounts.
examples.hi: हमें सभी खातों के लिए टू-फ़ैक्टर ऑथेंटिकेशन सेट करना होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will setup the server today.
common_mistake.right: I will set up the server today.
common_mistake.why: 'Setup' is a noun; the verb is written as two words: 'set up'.

cloze.sentence: HR will ____ ____ your email account on your first day.

en_def: to do or complete a task, test, or piece of work
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often write 'do a test' or 'perform testing'. 'Carry out' is the standard collocation for tests, checks, audits and attacks in reports.

examples.en: We carried out a full security audit last month.
examples.hi: हमने पिछले महीने पूरा सुरक्षा ऑडिट किया।

examples.en: The attackers carried out the intrusion over three days.
examples.hi: हमलावरों ने तीन दिनों में घुसपैठ को अंजाम दिया।

examples.en: Please carry out the checks before deploying.
examples.hi: डिप्लॉय करने से पहले कृपया जाँच पूरी करें।

examples.en: The survey was carried out in March.
examples.hi: सर्वे मार्च में किया गया था।

examples.en: They carried out the instructions exactly.
examples.hi: उन्होंने निर्देशों का ठीक-ठीक पालन किया।

common_mistake.wrong: We did the penetration testing on their app.
common_mistake.right: We carried out a penetration test on their app.
common_mistake.why: 'Carry out a test' is the natural professional collocation; 'do' is vague and 'testing' as a countable noun is unnatural.

cloze.sentence: The team will ____ ____ a vulnerability scan tonight.

en_def: to mention a topic; to raise a child
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'raise a point' (fine) or 'I was brought up by my grandparents' (correct). Avoid 'I grew up by my grandmother' — 'grow up' is what you do; 'bring up' is what parents do.

examples.en: Why did you bring up the salary issue in front of everyone?
examples.hi: तुमने सबके सामने वेतन का मुद्दा क्यों उठाया?

examples.en: She was brought up in a small village in Gujarat.
examples.hi: उसका पालन-पोषण गुजरात के एक छोटे गाँव में हुआ।

examples.en: I'll bring it up at the next stand-up.
examples.hi: मैं इसे अगली स्टैंड-अप में उठाऊँगा।

examples.en: Don't bring up politics at dinner.
examples.hi: खाने पर राजनीति की बात मत छेड़ो।

examples.en: They brought up three children on one income.
examples.hi: उन्होंने एक ही आय पर तीन बच्चों को पाला।

common_mistake.wrong: I grew up by my uncle in Surat.
common_mistake.right: I was brought up by my uncle in Surat.
common_mistake.why: 'Grow up' has no agent; when someone raises you, use the passive 'was brought up by'.

cloze.sentence: He ____ ____ the budget question during the review.

en_def: to find or meet something by chance; to seem a certain way to others
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'I came across a bug' (found by chance) and 'He comes across as rude' (seems). Hindi speakers rarely use the second one — it is very useful for feedback.

examples.en: I came across an old photo while cleaning.
examples.hi: सफ़ाई करते समय मुझे एक पुरानी तस्वीर मिल गई।

examples.en: We came across a serious flaw in the login flow.
examples.hi: हमें लॉगिन प्रक्रिया में एक गंभीर ख़ामी मिली।

examples.en: He comes across as confident in interviews.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू में वह आत्मविश्वासी लगता है।

examples.en: Have you ever come across this error before?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने पहले कभी यह एरर देखी है?

examples.en: Your email came across as a bit harsh.
examples.hi: तुम्हारा ईमेल थोड़ा कठोर लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I came across with a strange file.
common_mistake.right: I came across a strange file.
common_mistake.why: 'Come across' takes a direct object with no extra preposition.

cloze.sentence: I ____ ____ this word in an article yesterday.

en_def: to use all of something so that none is left
hi_nuance: Hindi 'ख़त्म हो गया' becomes 'the milk is finished' or 'my balance got over'. Natural English: 'we've run out of milk', 'I ran out of time'.

examples.en: We've run out of coffee again.
examples.hi: हमारी कॉफ़ी फिर ख़त्म हो गई।

examples.en: I ran out of time in the exam.
examples.hi: परीक्षा में मेरा समय ख़त्म हो गया।

examples.en: The car ran out of petrol on the highway.
examples.hi: हाईवे पर गाड़ी का पेट्रोल ख़त्म हो गया।

examples.en: The server ran out of memory and crashed.
examples.hi: सर्वर की मेमोरी ख़त्म हो गई और वह क्रैश हो गया।

examples.en: We're running out of options.
examples.hi: हमारे विकल्प ख़त्म होते जा रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My data got over, so I couldn't reply.
common_mistake.right: I ran out of data, so I couldn't reply.
common_mistake.why: 'Got over' is Indian English; standard English uses 'run out of'.

cloze.sentence: Hurry up — we're ____ ____ ____ time.

en_def: to remove clothing; (of a plane) to leave the ground; to become successful quickly
hi_def: उतारना; उड़ान भरना; तेज़ी से सफल होना
hi_nuance: Hindi 'जूते निकालो' becomes 'remove your shoes' — correct but formal. Everyday English is 'take off your shoes'. Also 'take a day off' = holiday.

examples.en: Please take off your shoes before entering.
examples.hi: कृपया अंदर आने से पहले अपने जूते उतारें।

examples.en: The flight took off twenty minutes late.
examples.hi: उड़ान बीस मिनट देर से रवाना हुई।

examples.en: Take it off; it's too hot for a jacket.
examples.hi: इसे उतार दो; जैकेट के लिए बहुत गर्मी है।

examples.en: Her career really took off after that project.
examples.hi: उस प्रोजेक्ट के बाद उसका करियर सचमुच चल पड़ा।

examples.en: I'm taking Friday off to visit my parents.
examples.hi: मैं अपने माता-पिता से मिलने के लिए शुक्रवार की छुट्टी ले रहा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Remove your jacket, it's warm inside.
common_mistake.right: Take off your jacket, it's warm inside.
common_mistake.why: 'Remove' is not wrong but sounds formal; 'take off' is the natural everyday verb for clothes.

cloze.sentence: The plane will ____ ____ as soon as the fog clears.

en_def: to solve or calculate; to exercise; to end well
hi_def: हल निकालना, हिसाब लगाना; व्यायाम करना; सफल होना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'I do gym' or 'I go for gymming'. Natural: 'I work out three times a week'. Also 'it worked out' = things went well.

examples.en: I work out at the gym before work.
examples.hi: मैं काम से पहले जिम में व्यायाम करता हूँ।

examples.en: Can you work out the total cost?
examples.hi: क्या तुम कुल लागत का हिसाब लगा सकते हो?

examples.en: Don't worry, it will all work out in the end.
examples.hi: चिंता मत करो, अंत में सब ठीक हो जाएगा।

examples.en: We worked out a plan to migrate the database.
examples.hi: हमने डेटाबेस माइग्रेट करने की योजना बनाई।

examples.en: Things didn't work out between them.
examples.hi: उन दोनों के बीच बात नहीं बनी।

common_mistake.wrong: I do gymming every morning.
common_mistake.right: I work out every morning.
common_mistake.why: 'Gymming' is not standard English; use 'work out' or 'go to the gym'.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ ____ how much each person owes.

en_def: to stop working (machine); to lose control emotionally; to divide into parts
hi_def: ख़राब हो जाना; टूट जाना (भावनात्मक रूप से); हिस्सों में बाँटना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'the car got spoiled' or 'my bike became bad'. Use 'broke down'. Note the noun 'breakdown' (one word).

examples.en: My car broke down on the way to the office.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस जाते समय मेरी गाड़ी ख़राब हो गई।

examples.en: She broke down in tears when she heard the news.
examples.hi: ख़बर सुनकर वह रो पड़ी।

examples.en: Let's break the task down into smaller steps.
examples.hi: आइए इस काम को छोटे-छोटे चरणों में बाँटें।

examples.en: Talks between the two companies broke down.
examples.hi: दोनों कंपनियों के बीच बातचीत टूट गई।

examples.en: The washing machine keeps breaking down.
examples.hi: वॉशिंग मशीन बार-बार ख़राब हो रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: My scooter got spoiled yesterday.
common_mistake.right: My scooter broke down yesterday.
common_mistake.why: Food gets spoiled; machines break down.

cloze.sentence: The lift ____ ____ and we had to use the stairs.

en_def: to reach the same level or position as others; to talk with someone about recent news
hi_nuance: 'Catch up with someone' = meet and chat; 'catch up on work' = do work you missed. Hindi speakers often say 'let's meet and discuss' — 'let's catch up' is the natural informal version.

examples.en: Let's catch up over coffee next week.
examples.hi: अगले हफ़्ते कॉफ़ी पर मिलते हैं।

examples.en: I need to catch up on emails after my holiday.
examples.hi: छुट्टी के बाद मुझे बचे हुए ईमेल निपटाने हैं।

examples.en: You go ahead — I'll catch up with you.
examples.hi: तुम आगे चलो — मैं तुम तक पहुँच जाऊँगा।

examples.en: She missed a week of classes and is struggling to catch up.
examples.hi: उसकी एक हफ़्ते की कक्षाएँ छूट गईं और अब वह बराबरी करने में जूझ रही है।

examples.en: It was great catching up with you yesterday.
examples.hi: कल तुमसे मिलकर बहुत अच्छा लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's catch up you tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: Let's catch up with you tomorrow. / Let's catch up tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'Catch up' takes 'with' before a person, or no object at all.

cloze.sentence: I've got a lot of reading to ____ ____ on this weekend.

en_def: to handle or solve a problem, task, or person
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often use 'handle' or 'tackle' for everything; 'deal with' is more common. Inseparable and always with 'with'.

examples.en: I'll deal with the customer complaint this afternoon.
examples.hi: मैं आज दोपहर ग्राहक की शिकायत निपटाऊँगा।

examples.en: How do you deal with stress at work?
examples.hi: तुम काम पर तनाव से कैसे निपटते हो?

examples.en: The support team deals with hundreds of tickets a day.
examples.hi: सपोर्ट टीम एक दिन में सैकड़ों टिकट निपटाती है।

examples.en: We need to deal with the critical vulnerabilities first.
examples.hi: हमें पहले गंभीर कमज़ोरियों से निपटना होगा।

examples.en: She's good at dealing with difficult people.
examples.hi: वह मुश्किल लोगों को सँभालने में अच्छी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will deal this issue tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will deal with this issue tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'Deal' needs 'with' before its object; without it the sentence is ungrammatical.

cloze.sentence: Who is going to ____ ____ the angry client?

en_def: to finally be in a place or situation, often unplanned
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers rarely use this; they say 'finally I reached'. 'End up' + -ing or + place is very common in natural speech.

examples.en: We ended up ordering pizza because the restaurant was full.
examples.hi: रेस्तराँ भरा होने की वजह से आख़िर हमने पिज़्ज़ा मँगवा लिया।

examples.en: He ended up in hospital after the accident.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना के बाद वह अस्पताल पहुँच गया।

examples.en: If you keep skipping backups, you'll end up losing data.
examples.hi: अगर तुम बैकअप छोड़ते रहे, तो आख़िर में डेटा खो बैठोगे।

examples.en: I ended up working until midnight.
examples.hi: आख़िर में मुझे आधी रात तक काम करना पड़ा।

examples.en: How did you end up in cybersecurity?
examples.hi: तुम साइबर सुरक्षा में कैसे आ गए?

common_mistake.wrong: We ended up to stay at home.
common_mistake.right: We ended up staying at home.
common_mistake.why: 'End up' is followed by the -ing form, not 'to' + verb.

cloze.sentence: After hours of debugging, I ____ ____ rewriting the whole module.

en_def: to have a friendly relationship with someone
hi_nuance: Hindi 'हमारी बनती है' = 'we get along'. Use 'get along with someone' or 'get on with' (British). Indian English often says 'we have good understanding' — unnatural.

examples.en: I get along well with my colleagues.
examples.hi: मेरी अपने सहकर्मियों से अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: Do you and your brother get along?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हारी और तुम्हारे भाई की बनती है?

examples.en: They don't get along at all.
examples.hi: उनकी बिल्कुल नहीं बनती।

examples.en: She gets along with everyone in the team.
examples.hi: टीम में सबके साथ उसकी अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: How are you getting along in the new job?
examples.hi: नई नौकरी में कैसा चल रहा है?

common_mistake.wrong: Me and my manager have very good understanding.
common_mistake.right: My manager and I get along really well.
common_mistake.why: 'Have good understanding' is Indian English; 'get along' is the natural expression for a good relationship.

cloze.sentence: It's important to ____ ____ with the people you work with.

en_def: to spend relaxed time with friends
hi_def: दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताना, घूमना-फिरना
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'we roamed around' or 'we did timepass'. 'Hang out' is the natural informal verb; 'timepass' does not exist in English.

examples.en: We usually hang out at the café after work.
examples.hi: हम आमतौर पर काम के बाद कैफ़े में समय बिताते हैं।

examples.en: Do you want to hang out this weekend?
examples.hi: क्या इस वीकेंड मिलना चाहोगे?

examples.en: She hangs out with her college friends every Friday.
examples.hi: वह हर शुक्रवार अपने कॉलेज के दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताती है।

examples.en: I just hung out at home and watched a series.
examples.hi: मैंने बस घर पर आराम किया और एक सीरीज़ देखी।

examples.en: Who do you hang out with at work?
examples.hi: काम पर तुम किसके साथ ज़्यादा समय बिताते हो?

common_mistake.wrong: We did timepass at the mall.
common_mistake.right: We hung out at the mall.
common_mistake.why: 'Timepass' is Indian English; English speakers say 'hang out' or 'kill time'.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ ____ on Saturday if you're free.

en_def: to wait for a short time; to keep holding something
hi_def: रुकना, थोड़ा इंतज़ार करना; पकड़े रहना
hi_nuance: Hindi 'एक मिनट रुको' → 'hold on a second'. On the phone, 'hold on' or 'hold the line' — not 'wait on the line'.

examples.en: Hold on, I'll check the calendar.
examples.hi: रुको, मैं कैलेंडर देखता हूँ।

examples.en: Can you hold on a minute? I'm on another call.
examples.hi: क्या एक मिनट रुक सकते हो? मैं दूसरे कॉल पर हूँ।

examples.en: Hold on tight — the road is bumpy.
examples.hi: कसकर पकड़ो — सड़क ऊबड़-खाबड़ है।

examples.en: Hold on, that doesn't sound right.
examples.hi: रुको, यह सही नहीं लग रहा।

examples.en: Please hold on while I transfer your call.
examples.hi: कृपया लाइन पर रहें, मैं आपका कॉल ट्रांसफ़र कर रहा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Wait on the line, I am checking.
common_mistake.right: Hold on, I'm just checking.
common_mistake.why: 'Wait on the line' is unnatural; 'hold on' is the idiomatic phone phrase.

cloze.sentence: ____ ____ a second — I think I've found the file.

en_def: to enter your username and password to start using a system
hi_nuance: Verb: 'log in' / 'log into' (two words). Noun/adjective: 'login' (one word) — 'the login page'. Indian English writes 'login to the portal' as a verb, which is wrong.

examples.en: Log in with your work email.
examples.hi: अपने ऑफ़िस ईमेल से लॉग इन करें।

examples.en: I can't log in — it says my password is wrong.
examples.hi: मैं लॉग इन नहीं कर पा रहा — यह कह रहा है कि पासवर्ड ग़लत है।

examples.en: You have to log into the VPN first.
examples.hi: पहले तुम्हें VPN में लॉग इन करना होगा।

examples.en: She logged in from an unknown device.
examples.hi: उसने एक अनजान डिवाइस से लॉग इन किया।

examples.en: Users must log in again after 30 minutes.
examples.hi: उपयोगकर्ताओं को 30 मिनट बाद फिर से लॉग इन करना होगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Please login to the dashboard.
common_mistake.right: Please log in to the dashboard.
common_mistake.why: As a verb it is two words: 'log in'. 'Login' is the noun or adjective.

cloze.sentence: You need to ____ ____ before you can see your tickets.

en_def: to end your session on a computer system
hi_nuance: Same pattern as 'log in': verb is two words. 'Logout button' (adjective) is one word.

examples.en: Always log out when you use a shared computer.
examples.hi: साझा कंप्यूटर इस्तेमाल करते समय हमेशा लॉग आउट करें।

examples.en: The system logs you out after ten minutes of inactivity.
examples.hi: दस मिनट निष्क्रिय रहने पर सिस्टम आपको लॉग आउट कर देता है।

examples.en: I logged out and logged back in, but it still doesn't work.
examples.hi: मैंने लॉग आउट करके फिर लॉग इन किया, पर अब भी काम नहीं कर रहा।

examples.en: Did you log out of your email on the hotel PC?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने होटल के PC पर अपने ईमेल से लॉग आउट किया?

examples.en: Click your name and choose 'Log out'.
examples.hi: अपने नाम पर क्लिक करें और 'लॉग आउट' चुनें।

common_mistake.wrong: I forgot to logout from Gmail.
common_mistake.right: I forgot to log out of Gmail.
common_mistake.why: Verb is 'log out' (two words) and the preposition is 'of', not 'from'.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ ____ of the admin panel when you're done.

en_def: to make a copy of data in case the original is lost; to support someone
hi_nuance: Verb: 'back up' (two words); noun: 'backup'. Indian English: 'take a backup' is common and acceptable, but 'back up the database' is more natural.

examples.en: Back up your files before you upgrade.
examples.hi: अपग्रेड करने से पहले अपनी फ़ाइलों का बैकअप लें।

examples.en: We back the database up every night.
examples.hi: हम हर रात डेटाबेस का बैकअप लेते हैं।

examples.en: Did you back it up before you ran the script?
examples.hi: स्क्रिप्ट चलाने से पहले क्या तुमने इसका बैकअप लिया था?

examples.en: My manager backed me up in the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग में मेरे मैनेजर ने मेरा साथ दिया।

examples.en: The data is backed up to the cloud automatically.
examples.hi: डेटा अपने आप क्लाउड पर बैकअप हो जाता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Did you backup the server?
common_mistake.right: Did you back up the server?
common_mistake.why: 'Backup' is the noun; the verb is written as two words.

cloze.sentence: Always ____ ____ your work before a big change.

en_def: to return a system or change to a previous state
hi_def: पिछली स्थिति में लौटाना, रोलबैक करना
hi_nuance: Verb 'roll back'; noun 'rollback'. Indian English sometimes says 'revert back' — 'revert' already means 'go back', so 'back' is redundant.

examples.en: We rolled back the deployment after the errors started.
examples.hi: एरर शुरू होने के बाद हमने डिप्लॉयमेंट रोलबैक कर दिया।

examples.en: Can you roll the change back?
examples.hi: क्या तुम बदलाव वापस ले सकते हो?

examples.en: If the patch fails, roll it back immediately.
examples.hi: अगर पैच फ़ेल हो, तो उसे तुरंत रोलबैक करो।

examples.en: The government rolled back the new tax.
examples.hi: सरकार ने नया कर वापस ले लिया।

examples.en: We have a plan to roll back to version 2.3.
examples.hi: हमारे पास वर्ज़न 2.3 पर वापस जाने की योजना है।

collocations: roll back to a previous version

common_mistake.wrong: We reverted back the release.
common_mistake.right: We rolled back the release. / We reverted the release.
common_mistake.why: 'Revert back' is redundant; use 'roll back' or just 'revert'.

cloze.sentence: The fix broke login, so we had to ____ it ____.

en_def: to turn off a computer or machine completely; to close a business permanently
hi_def: बंद करना (कंप्यूटर); स्थायी रूप से बंद हो जाना
hi_nuance: Verb 'shut down' (two words); noun 'shutdown'. Hindi speakers say 'close the laptop' when they mean shutting it down.

examples.en: Shut down your laptop before you leave.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले अपना लैपटॉप शट डाउन करें।

examples.en: The factory shut down in 2020.
examples.hi: फ़ैक्टरी 2020 में बंद हो गई।

examples.en: We shut the server down for maintenance.
examples.hi: हमने रखरखाव के लिए सर्वर बंद किया।

examples.en: Shut it down and restart it.
examples.hi: इसे बंद करो और फिर से चालू करो।

examples.en: The attack forced the company to shut down its website.
examples.hi: हमले के कारण कंपनी को अपनी वेबसाइट बंद करनी पड़ी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please shutdown the system.
common_mistake.right: Please shut down the system.
common_mistake.why: 'Shutdown' is the noun; the verb is written as two words.

cloze.sentence: IT asked everyone to ____ ____ their machines by 6 pm.

en_def: to take further action after something; to contact someone again about a matter
hi_nuance: Verb: 'follow up on / with' (two words). Noun/adjective: 'follow-up'. Indian English uses 'I will do follow-up' — say 'I'll follow up'.

examples.en: I'll follow up with the client on Monday.
examples.hi: मैं सोमवार को क्लाइंट से फ़ॉलो-अप करूँगा।

examples.en: Can you follow up on the ticket I raised yesterday?
examples.hi: क्या तुम मेरे कल उठाए टिकट पर फ़ॉलो-अप कर सकते हो?

examples.en: She followed up the interview with a thank-you email.
examples.hi: उसने इंटरव्यू के बाद धन्यवाद ईमेल भेजा।

examples.en: Nobody followed up, so the bug was never fixed.
examples.hi: किसी ने फ़ॉलो-अप नहीं किया, इसलिए बग कभी ठीक नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: Let's follow it up in tomorrow's call.
examples.hi: कल के कॉल में इस पर आगे बात करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I will do the follow up with him.
common_mistake.right: I'll follow up with him.
common_mistake.why: Use 'follow up' as a verb directly; 'do the follow up' is awkward.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ ____ with the vendor about the missing invoice.

en_def: to tell someone about a fact or mistake they might not have noticed
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers use 'tell' or 'show'. 'Point out' is perfect for code review: 'She pointed out a bug'. Separable.

examples.en: The reviewer pointed out three security issues.
examples.hi: समीक्षक ने तीन सुरक्षा समस्याओं की ओर ध्यान दिलाया।

examples.en: Thanks for pointing that out.
examples.hi: इसकी ओर ध्यान दिलाने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: I'd like to point out that the deadline is tomorrow.
examples.hi: मैं यह बताना चाहूँगा कि समय सीमा कल है।

examples.en: He pointed out the mistake in my calculation.
examples.hi: उसने मेरे हिसाब की ग़लती की ओर इशारा किया।

examples.en: As you pointed out, the logs were incomplete.
examples.hi: जैसा आपने बताया, लॉग अधूरे थे।

common_mistake.wrong: He pointed out me the error.
common_mistake.right: He pointed out the error to me.
common_mistake.why: The person receiving the information takes 'to'; the thing noticed is the direct object.

cloze.sentence: She ____ ____ that the API key was hard-coded.

en_def: to solve a problem or organise something that is messy
hi_nuance: Very common in British English. Hindi speakers often use 'solve' or 'settle'; 'sort out' covers problems, paperwork, arguments and messy rooms.

examples.en: I need to sort out my visa paperwork.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने वीज़ा के काग़ज़ात ठीक करने हैं।

examples.en: Have you sorted out the payment issue?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने भुगतान की समस्या सुलझा ली?

examples.en: Let's sort this out before the client notices.
examples.hi: क्लाइंट के ध्यान देने से पहले इसे सुलझा लेते हैं।

examples.en: She sorted the files out by date.
examples.hi: उसने फ़ाइलों को तारीख़ के हिसाब से व्यवस्थित किया।

examples.en: They sorted out their differences and are friends again.
examples.hi: उन्होंने अपने मतभेद सुलझा लिए और फिर दोस्त बन गए।

common_mistake.wrong: I will settle the DNS problem today.
common_mistake.right: I'll sort out the DNS problem today.
common_mistake.why: 'Settle' is for bills and disputes; for fixing technical or practical problems 'sort out' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Can you ____ ____ the seating for the workshop?

en_def: to dress yourself in clothing; to start a device or music playing
hi_nuance: 'Put on' is the action; 'wear' is the state. Hindi speakers say 'I wore my jacket and left' — natural: 'I put on my jacket and left'.

examples.en: Put on a jacket — it's cold outside.
examples.hi: जैकेट पहन लो — बाहर ठंड है।

examples.en: She put her shoes on and ran to the door.
examples.hi: उसने जूते पहने और दरवाज़े की ओर दौड़ी।

examples.en: Can you put on some music?
examples.hi: क्या तुम कुछ संगीत चला सकते हो?

examples.en: He put on his glasses to read the message.
examples.hi: उसने संदेश पढ़ने के लिए अपना चश्मा लगाया।

examples.en: Put it on and see if it fits.
examples.hi: इसे पहनकर देखो कि फ़िट है या नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I wore my shoes and went out.
common_mistake.right: I put on my shoes and went out.
common_mistake.why: 'Wear' describes a state; the action of getting dressed is 'put on'.

cloze.sentence: ____ ____ your helmet before you start the bike.

en_def: to continue; to happen
hi_def: जारी रखना; होना, चल रहा होना
hi_nuance: 'What's going on?' = what's happening. Hindi speakers use 'continue' too formally in speech; 'go on' is the everyday verb. Followed by -ing.

examples.en: What's going on with the servers?
examples.hi: सर्वरों के साथ क्या हो रहा है?

examples.en: Go on, I'm listening.
examples.hi: बोलते रहो, मैं सुन रहा हूँ।

examples.en: The meeting went on for three hours.
examples.hi: मीटिंग तीन घंटे तक चली।

examples.en: She went on talking even after the bell rang.
examples.hi: घंटी बजने के बाद भी वह बोलती रही।

examples.en: Something strange is going on in the logs.
examples.hi: लॉग में कुछ अजीब हो रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is happening there? (in chat, too formal)
common_mistake.right: What's going on there?
common_mistake.why: Not wrong, but 'what's going on' is the natural spoken form.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ ____ — tell me what happened next.

en_def: to return to a place
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'I will come back to you' meaning reply — English uses 'get back to you'. 'Come back' is physical return.

examples.en: When are you coming back from Delhi?
examples.hi: तुम दिल्ली से कब वापस आ रहे हो?

examples.en: She came back late last night.
examples.hi: वह कल रात देर से वापस आई।

examples.en: Come back soon!
examples.hi: जल्दी वापस आना!

examples.en: The error came back after the restart.
examples.hi: रीस्टार्ट के बाद एरर फिर आ गई।

examples.en: He left the company but came back a year later.
examples.hi: उसने कंपनी छोड़ दी लेकिन एक साल बाद वापस आ गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I will come back to you with the details.
common_mistake.right: I'll get back to you with the details.
common_mistake.why: For replying later, English uses 'get back to'; 'come back' means physically returning.

cloze.sentence: I'll ____ ____ in an hour to check on the build.

en_def: to contact someone later with a reply or information
hi_def: बाद में जवाब देना, संपर्क करना
hi_nuance: This replaces the Indian English 'revert' in emails. 'I'll revert by EOD' → 'I'll get back to you by EOD'.

examples.en: I'll get back to you by the end of the day.
examples.hi: मैं आज दिन ख़त्म होने तक आपको जवाब दूँगा।

examples.en: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly.
examples.hi: इतनी जल्दी जवाब देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Let me check and get back to you.
examples.hi: मुझे जाँचने दो, फिर मैं तुम्हें बताता हूँ।

examples.en: She never got back to me about the proposal.
examples.hi: उसने प्रस्ताव के बारे में मुझे कभी जवाब नहीं दिया।

examples.en: Can you get back to the client with a quote?
examples.hi: क्या तुम क्लाइंट को कोटेशन के साथ जवाब दे सकते हो?

common_mistake.wrong: Please revert at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Please get back to me as soon as possible.
common_mistake.why: 'Revert' means 'return to a previous state' in standard English, not 'reply'.

cloze.sentence: I'm in a meeting now — I'll ____ ____ ____ you in an hour.

en_def: to leave home for entertainment; to stop burning or shining
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'I went outside' for going to a restaurant or cinema. 'Go out' means going somewhere for fun; 'the lights went out' = power cut.

examples.en: We're going out for dinner tonight.
examples.hi: हम आज रात बाहर खाना खाने जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: The lights went out during the storm.
examples.hi: तूफ़ान के दौरान बत्तियाँ बुझ गईं।

examples.en: She doesn't go out much these days.
examples.hi: वह आजकल ज़्यादा बाहर नहीं जाती।

examples.en: They've been going out together for a year.
examples.hi: वे एक साल से एक-दूसरे को डेट कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: Let's go out and get some fresh air.
examples.hi: चलो बाहर चलकर थोड़ी ताज़ी हवा लेते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Yesterday we went outside for a movie.
common_mistake.right: Yesterday we went out to see a movie.
common_mistake.why: 'Outside' just means not indoors; 'go out' means going somewhere for entertainment.

cloze.sentence: Do you want to ____ ____ for a coffee later?

en_def: to think of an idea, plan, or solution
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers tend to say 'I got an idea' or 'I thought one solution'. Natural: 'I came up with a solution'.

examples.en: She came up with a clever workaround.
examples.hi: उसने एक चतुर उपाय सोच निकाला।

examples.en: We need to come up with a name for the project.
examples.hi: हमें प्रोजेक्ट के लिए एक नाम सोचना होगा।

examples.en: He always comes up with excuses.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा बहाने बना लेता है।

examples.en: Can you come up with three test cases by noon?
examples.hi: क्या तुम दोपहर तक तीन टेस्ट केस तैयार कर सकते हो?

examples.en: They came up with the idea during lunch.
examples.hi: उन्हें यह विचार दोपहर के भोजन के दौरान आया।

common_mistake.wrong: I thought one good idea for the demo.
common_mistake.right: I came up with a good idea for the demo.
common_mistake.why: 'Think an idea' is not English; use 'come up with' or 'have an idea'.

cloze.sentence: Marketing ____ ____ ____ a new slogan overnight.

en_def: to register on arrival at a hotel or airport; to contact someone briefly to see how things are
hi_nuance: 'Check in' at a hotel is standard. At work, 'let me check in with you' = a quick status chat. Noun is 'check-in'.

examples.en: We checked in at the hotel around noon.
examples.hi: हमने दोपहर के आसपास होटल में चेक-इन किया।

examples.en: You can check in online 24 hours before the flight.
examples.hi: आप उड़ान से 24 घंटे पहले ऑनलाइन चेक-इन कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: I'll check in with you on Friday to see how it's going.
examples.hi: मैं शुक्रवार को तुमसे हालचाल पूछूँगा कि काम कैसा चल रहा है।

examples.en: She checks in with her team every morning.
examples.hi: वह हर सुबह अपनी टीम से संपर्क करती है।

examples.en: Just checking in — do you need anything from me?
examples.hi: बस पूछ रहा हूँ — क्या तुम्हें मुझसे कुछ चाहिए?

common_mistake.wrong: I will do check-in at the airport at 5.
common_mistake.right: I'll check in at the airport at 5.
common_mistake.why: 'Check in' works as a verb by itself; 'do check-in' is unnatural.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ ____ with the vendor to see if the fix is ready.

en_def: to leave a hotel and pay; to look at something because it is interesting
hi_nuance: 'Check it out' = have a look — very common in speech. Hindi speakers say 'see this once' — natural: 'check this out'.

examples.en: We have to check out by 11 am.
examples.hi: हमें सुबह 11 बजे तक चेक-आउट करना है।

examples.en: Check out this new tool I found.
examples.hi: ये नया टूल देखो जो मुझे मिला।

examples.en: I'll check it out and let you know.
examples.hi: मैं इसे देखकर तुम्हें बताता हूँ।

examples.en: Have you checked out the new café near the office?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने ऑफ़िस के पास वाला नया कैफ़े देखा?

examples.en: The doctor checked him out and said he was fine.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसकी जाँच की और कहा कि वह ठीक है।

common_mistake.wrong: See this once, it's a great article.
common_mistake.right: Check this out — it's a great article.
common_mistake.why: 'See this once' is a direct Hindi translation; 'check this out' is the idiomatic version.

cloze.sentence: You should ____ ____ that podcast about incident response.

en_def: to complete a form; to give someone missing information; to do someone's job temporarily
hi_def: (फ़ॉर्म) भरना; जानकारी देना; किसी की जगह काम करना
hi_nuance: 'Fill in a form' (UK) / 'fill out a form' (US) — both fine. 'Fill me in' = tell me what I missed. Hindi speakers say 'update me' — 'fill me in' is more natural.

examples.en: Please fill in the form and sign at the bottom.
examples.hi: कृपया फ़ॉर्म भरें और नीचे हस्ताक्षर करें।

examples.en: Can you fill me in on what happened at the meeting?
examples.hi: क्या तुम मुझे बता सकते हो कि मीटिंग में क्या हुआ?

examples.en: She filled in for me while I was on leave.
examples.hi: जब मैं छुट्टी पर था तो उसने मेरी जगह काम किया।

examples.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct word.
examples.hi: सही शब्द से रिक्त स्थान भरें।

examples.en: I'll fill you in later; I'm in a hurry now.
examples.hi: मैं तुम्हें बाद में बताऊँगा; अभी जल्दी में हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Please fill the form and revert.
common_mistake.right: Please fill in the form and send it back.
common_mistake.why: 'Fill in / fill out' is the natural verb for forms, and 'revert' means something else in standard English.

cloze.sentence: I missed the call — can you ____ me ____?

en_def: to give work or a document to someone in authority
hi_nuance: Hindi 'जमा करना' is usually translated as 'submit' — fine in formal contexts. 'Hand in' is the everyday version; 'hand in your notice' = resign.

examples.en: Hand in your report by Friday.
examples.hi: शुक्रवार तक अपनी रिपोर्ट जमा करें।

examples.en: She handed in her notice last week.
examples.hi: उसने पिछले हफ़्ते इस्तीफ़ा दे दिया।

examples.en: Did you hand the assignment in on time?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने असाइनमेंट समय पर जमा किया?

examples.en: Please hand in your badge when you leave the building.
examples.hi: इमारत से निकलते समय कृपया अपना बैज जमा करें।

examples.en: He handed it in a day late.
examples.hi: उसने इसे एक दिन देर से जमा किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave my resignation yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I handed in my resignation yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'Give a resignation' is unidiomatic; 'hand in' or 'submit' is the correct collocation.

cloze.sentence: All students must ____ ____ their essays by noon.

en_def: to give something or responsibility to another person
hi_nuance: Very common at work: 'handover' (noun) before leaving a job. Verb is two words: 'hand over the project'.

examples.en: I'll hand over the project before I go on leave.
examples.hi: छुट्टी पर जाने से पहले मैं प्रोजेक्ट सौंप दूँगा।

examples.en: The guard asked him to hand over his ID.
examples.hi: गार्ड ने उससे अपना पहचान पत्र देने को कहा।

examples.en: She handed the keys over to the new tenant.
examples.hi: उसने चाबियाँ नए किरायेदार को सौंप दीं।

examples.en: The suspect was handed over to the police.
examples.hi: संदिग्ध को पुलिस के हवाले कर दिया गया।

examples.en: Hand it over — I'll finish it for you.
examples.hi: इसे मुझे दे दो — मैं इसे तुम्हारे लिए पूरा कर दूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I will do the handover of my tasks to Ravi.
common_mistake.right: I'll hand over my tasks to Ravi.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb form directly; 'do the handover of' is heavy and unnatural.

cloze.sentence: Before you leave, please ____ ____ all your passwords to IT.

en_def: to take control of something from someone else
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'hand over'. Noun 'takeover'. In security: 'account takeover' (ATO). Hindi speakers say 'I took charge' — also fine, but 'took over' is more common.

examples.en: Priya will take over the project from next month.
examples.hi: अगले महीने से प्रिया प्रोजेक्ट सँभालेगी।

examples.en: A larger company took over our startup.
examples.hi: एक बड़ी कंपनी ने हमारा स्टार्टअप ख़रीद लिया।

examples.en: Can you take over while I get some lunch?
examples.hi: जब तक मैं खाना खाता हूँ, क्या तुम सँभाल सकते हो?

examples.en: The attacker took over the admin account.
examples.hi: हमलावर ने एडमिन खाते पर नियंत्रण कर लिया।

examples.en: He took it over when the previous lead resigned.
examples.hi: जब पिछले लीड ने इस्तीफ़ा दिया तो उसने इसे सँभाल लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: He will take the charge of the team from Monday.
common_mistake.right: He'll take over the team from Monday.
common_mistake.why: 'Take the charge' is Indian English; use 'take over' or 'take charge of' (no 'the').

cloze.sentence: Who will ____ ____ your duties while you're away?

en_def: to arrive, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or heat
hi_nuance: 'Turn up' for people = show up. Hindi speakers say 'he came late' — 'he turned up late' adds the sense of casual or unexpected arrival.

examples.en: He turned up an hour late without an apology.
examples.hi: वह बिना माफ़ी माँगे एक घंटा देर से पहुँचा।

examples.en: Can you turn up the volume? I can't hear.
examples.hi: क्या आवाज़ बढ़ा सकते हो? मुझे सुनाई नहीं दे रहा।

examples.en: My lost wallet turned up in the car.
examples.hi: मेरा खोया हुआ बटुआ गाड़ी में मिल गया।

examples.en: Only five people turned up to the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग में सिर्फ़ पाँच लोग आए।

examples.en: Turn it up a bit — the speech is starting.
examples.hi: इसे थोड़ा बढ़ाओ — भाषण शुरू हो रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please increase the volume of the TV.
common_mistake.right: Please turn up the TV.
common_mistake.why: 'Increase the volume' is correct but stiff; 'turn up' is what people actually say.

cloze.sentence: Half the team didn't ____ ____ for the training.

en_def: to refuse an offer or request; to reduce the volume or heat
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'reject' for offers — 'turn down' is softer and more natural: 'she turned down the job'.

examples.en: She turned down the job offer because of the salary.
examples.hi: वेतन की वजह से उसने नौकरी का प्रस्ताव ठुकरा दिया।

examples.en: Turn the music down, please.
examples.hi: कृपया संगीत की आवाज़ कम करो।

examples.en: He turned it down without even reading it.
examples.hi: उसने इसे पढ़े बिना ही ठुकरा दिया।

examples.en: The bank turned down my loan application.
examples.hi: बैंक ने मेरा ऋण आवेदन अस्वीकार कर दिया।

examples.en: Can you turn down the AC? It's freezing.
examples.hi: क्या तुम AC कम कर सकते हो? बहुत ठंड है।

common_mistake.wrong: I rejected their offer politely.
common_mistake.right: I turned down their offer politely.
common_mistake.why: 'Reject' is strong and formal; 'turn down' is the natural, polite way to say no to an offer.

cloze.sentence: He ____ ____ the promotion because it meant moving to Mumbai.

en_def: to arrive at a place where people are expecting you
hi_nuance: American-leaning twin of 'turn up'. 'No-show' = someone who didn't show up. Hindi speakers say 'he didn't come' — fine, but 'didn't show up' is stronger.

examples.en: The candidate didn't show up for the interview.
examples.hi: उम्मीदवार इंटरव्यू के लिए नहीं आया।

examples.en: She showed up with a cake for everyone.
examples.hi: वह सबके लिए केक लेकर आई।

examples.en: What time did he show up?
examples.hi: वह कितने बजे आया?

examples.en: Just show up on time and you'll be fine.
examples.hi: बस समय पर पहुँचो और सब ठीक रहेगा।

examples.en: The bug only shows up in Safari.
examples.hi: यह बग सिर्फ़ सफ़ारी में दिखाई देता है।

common_mistake.wrong: He was absent for the meeting without informing.
common_mistake.right: He didn't show up for the meeting without letting anyone know.
common_mistake.why: 'Absent for' and 'without informing' (no object) are unnatural; this is how a native speaker would phrase it.

cloze.sentence: Twenty people registered but only eight ____ ____.

en_def: to recover from an illness, disappointment, or shock
hi_nuance: Note: 'get over' means recover, while Indian English 'my balance got over' means 'ran out' — that use is wrong in standard English.

examples.en: It took her weeks to get over the flu.
examples.hi: फ़्लू से उबरने में उसे कई हफ़्ते लगे।

examples.en: He still hasn't got over losing the match.
examples.hi: वह अब भी मैच हारने के सदमे से नहीं उबरा है।

examples.en: You'll get over it — everyone fails sometimes.
examples.hi: तुम इससे उबर जाओगे — हर कोई कभी न कभी असफल होता है।

examples.en: I can't get over how fast the kids have grown.
examples.hi: मुझे यक़ीन नहीं होता कि बच्चे कितनी जल्दी बड़े हो गए।

examples.en: She got over her fear of public speaking.
examples.hi: उसने सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलने के अपने डर पर क़ाबू पा लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: My internet pack got over yesterday.
common_mistake.right: My internet pack ran out yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'Got over' means recovered; for something being used up, say 'ran out' or 'expired'.

cloze.sentence: It took him a long time to ____ ____ the loss of his job.

en_def: to finish or survive something difficult; to reach someone by phone
hi_def: पार पाना, पूरा करना; फ़ोन पर संपर्क हो पाना
hi_nuance: 'I couldn't get through' = the call didn't connect. Hindi speakers say 'the call was not going' — use 'I couldn't get through'.

examples.en: I tried calling but couldn't get through.
examples.hi: मैंने फ़ोन करने की कोशिश की लेकिन बात नहीं हो पाई।

examples.en: We got through a lot of work today.
examples.hi: हमने आज बहुत सारा काम निपटा लिया।

examples.en: She got through the exam with flying colours.
examples.hi: उसने परीक्षा शानदार अंकों से पास की।

examples.en: How did you get through such a tough year?
examples.hi: तुमने इतना कठिन साल कैसे निकाला?

examples.en: I need coffee to get through the afternoon.
examples.hi: दोपहर निकालने के लिए मुझे कॉफ़ी चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: Your call was not going through, so I messaged.
common_mistake.right: I couldn't get through, so I messaged you.
common_mistake.why: 'Get through' is the idiom for a call connecting; 'call was not going' is a Hindi calque.

cloze.sentence: I've been trying to ____ ____ to support for an hour.

en_def: to examine something carefully; to experience something difficult
hi_def: ध्यान से देखना/जाँचना; (कठिन समय) से गुज़रना
hi_nuance: Perfect for work: 'let's go through the report'. Hindi speakers say 'let's see the document one time' — use 'go through'.

examples.en: Let's go through the findings one by one.
examples.hi: चलो नतीजों को एक-एक करके देखते हैं।

examples.en: She's going through a difficult time right now.
examples.hi: वह इस समय एक मुश्किल दौर से गुज़र रही है।

examples.en: I went through the logs but found nothing unusual.
examples.hi: मैंने लॉग देखे लेकिन कुछ असामान्य नहीं मिला।

examples.en: The payment didn't go through.
examples.hi: भुगतान सफल नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: Can we go through the plan again before the call?
examples.hi: क्या हम कॉल से पहले योजना को फिर से देख सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: Please see the document once and tell me.
common_mistake.right: Please go through the document and let me know.
common_mistake.why: 'See once' is a Hindi calque ('एक बार देख लो'); 'go through' is the natural verb for reviewing.

cloze.sentence: We need to ____ ____ every line of the contract.

en_def: to investigate or examine a problem
hi_nuance: The polite professional way to say 'I'll investigate'. Hindi speakers write 'I will check on this' — 'I'll look into it' is standard.

examples.en: I'll look into the issue and get back to you.
examples.hi: मैं इस समस्या की जाँच करके आपको बताऊँगा।

examples.en: The police are looking into the theft.
examples.hi: पुलिस चोरी की जाँच कर रही है।

examples.en: Thanks for raising this — we're looking into it.
examples.hi: इसे उठाने के लिए धन्यवाद — हम इसकी जाँच कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: Could you look into why the build is failing?
examples.hi: क्या तुम देख सकते हो कि बिल्ड क्यों फ़ेल हो रही है?

examples.en: We looked into several vendors before choosing one.
examples.hi: एक चुनने से पहले हमने कई विक्रेताओं की जाँच की।

common_mistake.wrong: I will look into it and revert.
common_mistake.right: I'll look into it and get back to you.
common_mistake.why: 'Look into' is correct, but 'revert' should be 'get back to you'.

cloze.sentence: Our team will ____ ____ the reported vulnerability today.

en_def: to feel happy and excited about something that is going to happen
hi_nuance: The number-one email error: 'I look forward to meet you'. The 'to' is a preposition, so it must be followed by -ing or a noun.

examples.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
examples.hi: मुझे आपके जवाब का इंतज़ार रहेगा।

examples.en: We're looking forward to the holidays.
examples.hi: हम छुट्टियों का बेसब्री से इंतज़ार कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: She's looking forward to starting her new job.
examples.hi: वह अपनी नई नौकरी शुरू करने के लिए उत्सुक है।

examples.en: I'm not looking forward to the dentist tomorrow.
examples.hi: कल डेंटिस्ट के पास जाने का मुझे बिल्कुल मन नहीं है।

examples.en: Looking forward to working with you.
examples.hi: आपके साथ काम करने के लिए उत्सुक हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I look forward to meet you next week.
common_mistake.right: I look forward to meeting you next week.
common_mistake.why: 'To' here is a preposition, not part of an infinitive, so the verb takes -ing.

cloze.sentence: I ____ ____ ____ seeing you at the conference.

en_def: to continue doing a task; to have a good relationship with someone
hi_def: काम जारी रखना; अच्छे संबंध होना
hi_nuance: British English. 'Get on with it!' = stop wasting time. 'I get on with my boss' = we have a good relationship.

examples.en: Let's get on with the review — we're short on time.
examples.hi: चलो समीक्षा जारी रखते हैं — समय कम है।

examples.en: I get on well with my flatmates.
examples.hi: मेरी अपने फ़्लैटमेट्स से अच्छी बनती है।

examples.en: Stop chatting and get on with your work.
examples.hi: बातें बंद करो और अपना काम करो।

examples.en: How are you getting on with the new framework?
examples.hi: नए फ़्रेमवर्क के साथ कैसा चल रहा है?

examples.en: They don't really get on with each other.
examples.hi: उनकी आपस में ख़ास नहीं बनती।

common_mistake.wrong: Let's continue with the work now, no more talking.
common_mistake.right: Let's get on with it — no more talking.
common_mistake.why: Not wrong, but 'get on with it' is the idiomatic, energetic version.

cloze.sentence: I'd better ____ ____ ____ the report before lunch.

en_def: to move or progress at the same speed as someone or something
hi_nuance: 'Keep up with the news / technology / the team'. Hindi speakers say 'stay updated' — 'keep up with' is more natural in speech.

examples.en: It's hard to keep up with all the new security tools.
examples.hi: सभी नए सुरक्षा टूल्स के साथ तालमेल रखना मुश्किल है।

examples.en: Slow down — I can't keep up with you.
examples.hi: धीरे चलो — मैं तुम्हारी रफ़्तार से नहीं चल पा रहा।

examples.en: She reads every morning to keep up with the news.
examples.hi: ख़बरों से जुड़े रहने के लिए वह हर सुबह पढ़ती है।

examples.en: We couldn't keep up with the demand.
examples.hi: हम माँग के साथ तालमेल नहीं रख पाए।

examples.en: Do you keep up with your college friends?
examples.hi: क्या तुम अपने कॉलेज के दोस्तों के संपर्क में रहते हो?

common_mistake.wrong: I try to be updated with the latest CVEs.
common_mistake.right: I try to keep up with the latest CVEs.
common_mistake.why: 'Be updated' is a Hindi-style passive; 'keep up with' is the natural active phrase.

cloze.sentence: The old server can't ____ ____ ____ the traffic any more.

en_def: to stop the supply of something; to interrupt a call or a person speaking
hi_nuance: 'We got cut off' = the call dropped. Hindi speakers say 'the call got disconnected' — fine, but 'we got cut off' is what natives say.

examples.en: Sorry, we got cut off — bad signal.
examples.hi: माफ़ करना, कॉल कट गया — सिग्नल ख़राब था।

examples.en: They cut off the power for maintenance.
examples.hi: रखरखाव के लिए उन्होंने बिजली काट दी।

examples.en: Don't cut me off — let me finish.
examples.hi: मुझे बीच में मत टोको — मुझे पूरा करने दो।

examples.en: The village was cut off by the floods.
examples.hi: बाढ़ की वजह से गाँव का संपर्क कट गया।

examples.en: The firewall cut off all outbound traffic.
examples.hi: फ़ायरवॉल ने सारा आउटबाउंड ट्रैफ़िक रोक दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: The line got disconnected in between.
common_mistake.right: We got cut off halfway through.
common_mistake.why: 'In between' without an object is a Hindi calque; 'halfway through' and 'cut off' are natural.

cloze.sentence: The company ____ ____ his access the day he resigned.

en_def: to cancel a planned event
hi_nuance: 'Cancel' is fine; 'call off' is common for meetings, strikes, matches. Separable: 'call it off'.

examples.en: The match was called off because of rain.
examples.hi: बारिश की वजह से मैच रद्द कर दिया गया।

examples.en: They called off the strike after talks.
examples.hi: बातचीत के बाद उन्होंने हड़ताल वापस ले ली।

examples.en: Let's call it off — half the team is sick.
examples.hi: इसे रद्द कर देते हैं — आधी टीम बीमार है।

examples.en: The wedding was called off at the last minute.
examples.hi: शादी आख़िरी समय पर रद्द कर दी गई।

examples.en: We called off the release when the tests failed.
examples.hi: टेस्ट फ़ेल होने पर हमने रिलीज़ रद्द कर दी।

common_mistake.wrong: The meeting is cancel due to rain.
common_mistake.right: The meeting has been called off because of the rain.
common_mistake.why: 'Is cancel' is missing the past participle; 'called off' with the correct passive form is natural.

cloze.sentence: They had to ____ ____ the event at the last minute.

en_def: to start a new hobby or activity; to occupy space or time
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'I started learning guitar' — fine; 'I took up the guitar' is more natural. 'It takes up too much time' = consumes.

examples.en: I took up running last year.
examples.hi: मैंने पिछले साल दौड़ना शुरू किया।

examples.en: This desk takes up too much space.
examples.hi: यह मेज़ बहुत ज़्यादा जगह लेती है।

examples.en: She took up the offer immediately.
examples.hi: उसने तुरंत प्रस्ताव स्वीकार कर लिया।

examples.en: Sorry to take up so much of your time.
examples.hi: आपका इतना समय लेने के लिए क्षमा करें।

examples.en: He's thinking of taking up photography.
examples.hi: वह फ़ोटोग्राफ़ी शुरू करने की सोच रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have joined swimming from this month.
common_mistake.right: I've taken up swimming this month.
common_mistake.why: 'Joined swimming' is Indian English; 'take up' is the verb for starting a new activity.

cloze.sentence: The logs ____ ____ 80% of the disk.

en_def: to tolerate something unpleasant without complaining
hi_nuance: Hindi 'बर्दाश्त करना' → 'tolerate' (formal) or 'put up with' (everyday). Three-word, inseparable.

examples.en: I don't know how she puts up with that noise.
examples.hi: पता नहीं वह उस शोर को कैसे बर्दाश्त करती है।

examples.en: We put up with the slow Wi-Fi for months.
examples.hi: हमने महीनों तक धीमा वाई-फ़ाई सहन किया।

examples.en: I won't put up with rude customers.
examples.hi: मैं असभ्य ग्राहकों को बर्दाश्त नहीं करूँगा।

examples.en: He had to put up with a lot of criticism.
examples.hi: उसे बहुत आलोचना सहनी पड़ी।

examples.en: Thanks for putting up with me during the migration.
examples.hi: माइग्रेशन के दौरान मुझे झेलने के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: I can't bear up with this behaviour.
common_mistake.right: I can't put up with this behaviour.
common_mistake.why: 'Bear up with' mixes two expressions; the correct phrasal verb is 'put up with'.

cloze.sentence: How do you ____ ____ ____ such long commutes every day?

en_def: to cause something to happen, usually a change
hi_nuance: Formal-ish; common in reports: 'the policy brought about a reduction in incidents'. Hindi speakers over-use 'cause' or 'result in' — this is a natural alternative.

examples.en: The new policy brought about a big drop in phishing incidents.
examples.hi: नई नीति से फ़िशिंग घटनाओं में बड़ी गिरावट आई।

examples.en: What brought about the change in his attitude?
examples.hi: उसके रवैये में बदलाव किस कारण आया?

examples.en: The merger brought about hundreds of job losses.
examples.hi: विलय के कारण सैकड़ों नौकरियाँ चली गईं।

examples.en: Remote work has brought about new security risks.
examples.hi: रिमोट वर्क ने नए सुरक्षा जोखिम पैदा किए हैं।

examples.en: They hope to bring about reform through education.
examples.hi: वे शिक्षा के माध्यम से सुधार लाने की उम्मीद करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The update brought a lot of changes about the UI.
common_mistake.right: The update brought about a lot of changes to the UI.
common_mistake.why: 'Bring about' is a unit meaning 'cause'; 'about' cannot be moved to describe the topic.

cloze.sentence: Automation has ____ ____ a shift in how we triage alerts.

en_def: to do something wrong without being caught or punished
hi_nuance: Three-word, inseparable. Very common in security talk: 'attackers got away with 2 million records'. Hindi speakers might say 'escaped' — less precise.

examples.en: The attackers got away with a full customer database.
examples.hi: हमलावर पूरा ग्राहक डेटाबेस लेकर बच निकले।

examples.en: He got away with cheating on the test.
examples.hi: वह परीक्षा में नक़ल करके बच गया।

examples.en: You won't get away with this.
examples.hi: तुम इससे बच नहीं पाओगे।

examples.en: She got away with arriving late every day.
examples.hi: वह रोज़ देर से आकर भी बच जाती थी।

examples.en: How did they get away with it for so long?
examples.hi: वे इतने लंबे समय तक इससे कैसे बचते रहे?

common_mistake.wrong: They escaped with the data without any punishment.
common_mistake.right: They got away with the data.
common_mistake.why: 'Get away with' already includes the meaning of not being caught or punished.

cloze.sentence: Nobody should ____ ____ ____ bypassing the security review.

en_def: to reduce the amount of something you use or do
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'reduce sugar' — correct but 'cut down on sugar' is the idiom. Note the pattern: cut down on + noun.

examples.en: I'm trying to cut down on sugar.
examples.hi: मैं चीनी कम करने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: We need to cut down on cloud costs this quarter.
examples.hi: इस तिमाही में हमें क्लाउड लागत कम करनी होगी।

examples.en: He cut down on smoking before quitting completely.
examples.hi: पूरी तरह छोड़ने से पहले उसने धूम्रपान कम किया।

examples.en: Cut down on the number of meetings and people will be happier.
examples.hi: मीटिंगों की संख्या कम करो और लोग ज़्यादा ख़ुश रहेंगे।

examples.en: The doctor told her to cut down on salt.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने उसे नमक कम करने को कहा।

common_mistake.wrong: I have cut down my coffee to one cup.
common_mistake.right: I've cut down on coffee — just one cup now.
common_mistake.why: With 'cut down' the reduced thing normally takes 'on'; 'cut down my coffee' sounds like cutting a tree.

cloze.sentence: You should ____ ____ ____ late-night screen time.

en_def: to be easily noticed because of being different or better
hi_nuance: Great for CVs and reviews: 'her report stood out'. Hindi speakers say 'was different from others' — 'stood out' is compact and natural.

examples.en: One candidate really stood out in the interviews.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू में एक उम्मीदवार सचमुच अलग नज़र आया।

examples.en: The red button stands out on the dark background.
examples.hi: गहरे बैकग्राउंड पर लाल बटन अलग दिखता है।

examples.en: Her writing stands out for its clarity.
examples.hi: उसका लेखन अपनी स्पष्टता के लिए अलग नज़र आता है।

examples.en: What made this incident stand out from the others?
examples.hi: किस बात ने इस घटना को दूसरों से अलग बनाया?

examples.en: He stood out because he asked good questions.
examples.hi: वह इसलिए अलग दिखा क्योंकि उसने अच्छे सवाल पूछे।

common_mistake.wrong: This resume is looking different than others.
common_mistake.right: This CV really stands out.
common_mistake.why: 'Looking different than others' is clumsy; 'stands out' conveys 'noticeably better'.

cloze.sentence: Two findings ____ ____ as critical in the report.

en_def: to decide that something is impossible or not an option
hi_def: संभावना से बाहर करना, ख़ारिज करना
hi_nuance: Essential for incident reports: 'we ruled out insider involvement'. Hindi speakers say 'we rejected the possibility' — 'rule out' is standard.

examples.en: We can't rule out a supply-chain attack yet.
examples.hi: हम अभी सप्लाई-चेन हमले की संभावना को ख़ारिज नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: The doctor ruled out anything serious.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने किसी गंभीर बीमारी की संभावना को ख़ारिज कर दिया।

examples.en: They've ruled out moving the office this year.
examples.hi: उन्होंने इस साल ऑफ़िस शिफ़्ट करने का विचार ख़ारिज कर दिया है।

examples.en: Rule it out only after you've checked the logs.
examples.hi: लॉग जाँचने के बाद ही इसे ख़ारिज करो।

examples.en: Bad weather ruled out the outdoor event.
examples.hi: ख़राब मौसम की वजह से बाहर का कार्यक्रम संभव नहीं रहा।

common_mistake.wrong: We rejected the possibility of insider threat.
common_mistake.right: We ruled out an insider threat.
common_mistake.why: 'Rule out' is the standard phrase for eliminating a possibility; 'rejected the possibility' is heavy.

cloze.sentence: The investigators haven't ____ ____ human error.

en_def: to reduce the number of possibilities or options
hi_nuance: Pairs with 'rule out' in troubleshooting. Hindi speakers say 'shortlist' (noun used as verb) — fine, but 'narrow down' is broader.

examples.en: We narrowed down the cause to two possible services.
examples.hi: हमने कारण को दो संभावित सेवाओं तक सीमित कर दिया।

examples.en: Can you narrow down the list to five candidates?
examples.hi: क्या तुम सूची को पाँच उम्मीदवारों तक सीमित कर सकते हो?

examples.en: The logs helped us narrow it down.
examples.hi: लॉग ने हमें इसे सीमित करने में मदद की।

examples.en: I've narrowed my choice down to two laptops.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी पसंद दो लैपटॉप तक सीमित कर ली है।

examples.en: Let's narrow down the time window of the breach.
examples.hi: आइए उल्लंघन की समय-सीमा को सीमित करें।

common_mistake.wrong: We shortlisted the root cause to the auth service.
common_mistake.right: We narrowed down the root cause to the auth service.
common_mistake.why: 'Shortlist' is for candidates or items; for reducing possibilities use 'narrow down'.

cloze.sentence: We've ____ ____ the suspects to three IP ranges.

en_def: to examine or review something carefully
hi_nuance: Similar to 'go through'. 'Go over the plan again' = review it. Hindi speakers say 'revise' — 'go over' is the spoken form.

examples.en: Let's go over the steps one more time.
examples.hi: चलो चरणों को एक बार फिर देखते हैं।

examples.en: She went over my essay and marked the errors.
examples.hi: उसने मेरा निबंध देखा और ग़लतियाँ चिह्नित कीं।

examples.en: We went over budget on the project.
examples.hi: हम प्रोजेक्ट में बजट से ऊपर चले गए।

examples.en: I'll go over the contract before signing.
examples.hi: मैं हस्ताक्षर करने से पहले अनुबंध देख लूँगा।

examples.en: Can we go over the findings before the client call?
examples.hi: क्या हम क्लाइंट कॉल से पहले नतीजे देख सकते हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: Let's revise the plan once before the demo.
common_mistake.right: Let's go over the plan once more before the demo.
common_mistake.why: 'Revise' means change; 'go over' means review without necessarily changing.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ ____ the checklist before you deploy.

en_def: to stop demanding something or admit you were wrong after an argument
hi_def: पीछे हटना, हार मान लेना (बहस में)
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'he stepped back'. 'Back down' implies giving up a position in an argument.

examples.en: Neither side was willing to back down.
examples.hi: कोई भी पक्ष पीछे हटने को तैयार नहीं था।

examples.en: The vendor backed down after we showed the evidence.
examples.hi: सबूत दिखाने के बाद विक्रेता पीछे हट गया।

examples.en: Don't back down — your point is valid.
examples.hi: पीछे मत हटो — तुम्हारी बात सही है।

examples.en: She refused to back down on the deadline.
examples.hi: उसने समय सीमा पर पीछे हटने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: He backed down as soon as the manager arrived.
examples.hi: मैनेजर के आते ही वह पीछे हट गया।

common_mistake.wrong: Finally the client stepped back from their demand.
common_mistake.right: Finally the client backed down.
common_mistake.why: 'Step back' means pause or take a broader view; 'back down' means withdraw from a position.

cloze.sentence: They eventually ____ ____ and accepted our terms.

en_def: to continue doing or using something and not change
hi_nuance: Hindi 'पर कायम रहना'. 'Stick to the plan / the rules / the point'. Indian English says 'follow the plan' — fine, but 'stick to' adds the sense of not deviating.

examples.en: Let's stick to the plan.
examples.hi: चलो योजना पर टिके रहते हैं।

examples.en: Stick to the point — we only have ten minutes.
examples.hi: मुद्दे पर रहो — हमारे पास सिर्फ़ दस मिनट हैं।

examples.en: If you stick to the checklist, you won't miss anything.
examples.hi: अगर तुम चेकलिस्ट पर टिके रहोगे तो कुछ नहीं छूटेगा।

examples.en: He stuck to his story despite the evidence.
examples.hi: सबूतों के बावजूद वह अपनी बात पर अड़ा रहा।

examples.en: I'm trying to stick to a budget this month.
examples.hi: मैं इस महीने बजट पर टिके रहने की कोशिश कर रहा हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: Please stick with the topic only.
common_mistake.right: Please stick to the topic.
common_mistake.why: 'Stick with' means stay loyal to a person or choice; 'stick to' means not deviate from a rule or subject.

cloze.sentence: Whatever happens, ____ ____ the agreed process.

en_def: to phone someone again, or in return for their call
hi_nuance: Indian English: 'I will call you back' is correct; 'I will revert you' is not. Also 'a callback' (noun) in programming.

examples.en: Can I call you back in ten minutes?
examples.hi: क्या मैं तुम्हें दस मिनट में वापस फ़ोन कर सकता हूँ?

examples.en: She said she'd call back after lunch.
examples.hi: उसने कहा कि वह दोपहर के भोजन के बाद फ़ोन करेगी।

examples.en: I called him back but got voicemail.
examples.hi: मैंने उसे वापस फ़ोन किया लेकिन वॉइसमेल लगा।

examples.en: Please call me back on this number.
examples.hi: कृपया मुझे इसी नंबर पर वापस फ़ोन करें।

examples.en: Nobody from support ever called back.
examples.hi: सपोर्ट से किसी ने कभी वापस फ़ोन नहीं किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I will call you after some time.
common_mistake.right: I'll call you back in a bit.
common_mistake.why: 'After some time' is vague Hindi-style; 'call back in a bit / in ten minutes' is natural.

cloze.sentence: I'm driving — can I ____ you ____ later?

en_def: to end a phone call
hi_nuance: Hindi 'फ़ोन काटना' becomes 'cut the call' in Indian English — not standard. Use 'hang up' or 'end the call'.

examples.en: Don't hang up — I need one more minute.
examples.hi: फ़ोन मत काटो — मुझे एक मिनट और चाहिए।

examples.en: She hung up before I could explain.
examples.hi: मेरे समझाने से पहले ही उसने फ़ोन काट दिया।

examples.en: He hung up on me!
examples.hi: उसने मेरा फ़ोन काट दिया!

examples.en: Hang up and I'll call you from the landline.
examples.hi: फ़ोन रखो, मैं तुम्हें लैंडलाइन से फ़ोन करता हूँ।

examples.en: The customer hung up after waiting for 20 minutes.
examples.hi: 20 मिनट इंतज़ार के बाद ग्राहक ने फ़ोन काट दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: He cut the call in the middle.
common_mistake.right: He hung up halfway through.
common_mistake.why: 'Cut the call' is a Hindi calque; native speakers say 'hang up'.

cloze.sentence: Please don't ____ ____ — your call is important to us.

en_def: to take someone or something to a place and leave them there; to fall asleep; to decrease
hi_nuance: Opposite of 'pick up'. Hindi speakers say 'I will drop you' — natural British English also says 'drop you off' or just 'drop you'. Both are fine.

examples.en: I'll drop you off at the station.
examples.hi: मैं तुम्हें स्टेशन पर छोड़ दूँगा।

examples.en: Can you drop the parcel off at reception?
examples.hi: क्या तुम पार्सल रिसेप्शन पर छोड़ सकते हो?

examples.en: I dropped off during the long lecture.
examples.hi: लंबे लेक्चर के दौरान मुझे झपकी आ गई।

examples.en: Sales dropped off sharply in March.
examples.hi: मार्च में बिक्री तेज़ी से गिरी।

examples.en: Drop the kids off and then come to the meeting.
examples.hi: बच्चों को छोड़कर फिर मीटिंग में आओ।

common_mistake.wrong: I will leave you at the airport at 6.
common_mistake.right: I'll drop you off at the airport at 6.
common_mistake.why: 'Leave you' can sound like abandoning someone; 'drop off' is the clear, friendly verb.

cloze.sentence: Could you ____ me ____ near the metro?

en_def: to die (polite expression)
hi_nuance: The gentle way to say 'die'. Indian English 'expired' for a person sounds like a passport or licence — avoid it. Also NOT 'pass out' (which means faint or, in Indian English, graduate).

examples.en: My grandfather passed away last year.
examples.hi: मेरे दादाजी का पिछले साल देहांत हो गया।

examples.en: She passed away peacefully in her sleep.
examples.hi: वह नींद में शांति से गुज़र गई।

examples.en: I'm sorry to hear that your uncle passed away.
examples.hi: आपके चाचा के निधन के बारे में सुनकर दुख हुआ।

examples.en: He passed away after a long illness.
examples.hi: लंबी बीमारी के बाद उनका देहांत हो गया।

examples.en: Her mother passed away when she was ten.
examples.hi: जब वह दस साल की थी तब उसकी माँ गुज़र गईं।

common_mistake.wrong: His father expired last month.
common_mistake.right: His father passed away last month.
common_mistake.why: 'Expire' is used for documents and products; for people, English uses 'pass away' or 'die'.

cloze.sentence: Sadly, our old colleague ____ ____ over the weekend.

en_def: to lose consciousness; to distribute things to a group
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'passed out from college' to mean graduated — in standard English this means fainted. Say 'graduated from'.

examples.en: He passed out from the heat and was taken to hospital.
examples.hi: गर्मी से वह बेहोश हो गया और उसे अस्पताल ले जाया गया।

examples.en: The teacher passed out the worksheets.
examples.hi: शिक्षक ने वर्कशीट बाँटीं।

examples.en: She nearly passed out when she saw the bill.
examples.hi: बिल देखकर वह लगभग बेहोश हो गई।

examples.en: Pass these out to everyone at the table.
examples.hi: इन्हें मेज़ पर सबको बाँट दो।

examples.en: I graduated in 2018 — not 'passed out'.
examples.hi: मैंने 2018 में स्नातक किया — 'पास आउट' नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I passed out from IIT in 2016.
common_mistake.right: I graduated from IIT in 2016.
common_mistake.why: In standard English 'pass out' means faint; the verb for finishing a degree is 'graduate'.

cloze.sentence: Two runners ____ ____ from dehydration during the marathon.

en_def: to talk louder; to express your opinion openly
hi_def: ज़ोर से बोलना; खुलकर अपनी बात कहना
hi_nuance: Two meanings: 'Speak up, I can't hear you' and 'Speak up if you disagree'. Hindi speakers say 'talk loudly' — 'speak up' is what natives say.

examples.en: Could you speak up? The line is bad.
examples.hi: क्या आप ज़ोर से बोल सकते हैं? लाइन ख़राब है।

examples.en: If you see something wrong, speak up.
examples.hi: अगर कुछ ग़लत दिखे तो खुलकर बोलो।

examples.en: She spoke up in the meeting about the security gaps.
examples.hi: उसने मीटिंग में सुरक्षा कमियों के बारे में खुलकर बात की।

examples.en: Nobody spoke up, so the decision went through.
examples.hi: किसी ने कुछ नहीं कहा, इसलिए फ़ैसला पारित हो गया।

examples.en: Please speak up for the people at the back.
examples.hi: कृपया पीछे बैठे लोगों के लिए ज़ोर से बोलें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please talk loudly, I am not able to hear.
common_mistake.right: Please speak up, I can't hear you.
common_mistake.why: 'Talk loudly' sounds like a complaint; 'speak up' is the polite request.

cloze.sentence: Don't be afraid to ____ ____ if you disagree.

en_def: to admire and respect someone
hi_nuance: Three-word. Opposite is 'look down on'. Hindi speakers say 'he is my inspiration' — 'I look up to him' is the verb form.
