examples.en: I've always looked up to my older sister.
examples.hi: मैंने हमेशा अपनी बड़ी बहन को आदर्श माना है।

examples.en: The juniors look up to her as a mentor.
examples.hi: जूनियर उसे एक मेंटर के रूप में आदर देते हैं।

examples.en: Who did you look up to when you were young?
examples.hi: बचपन में तुम किसे अपना आदर्श मानते थे?

examples.en: He's someone the whole team looks up to.
examples.hi: वह ऐसा व्यक्ति है जिसका पूरी टीम सम्मान करती है।

examples.en: Kids look up to athletes and film stars.
examples.hi: बच्चे खिलाड़ियों और फ़िल्म सितारों को आदर्श मानते हैं।

collocations: look up to as a role model

common_mistake.wrong: He is my inspiration since childhood.
common_mistake.right: I've looked up to him since I was a child.
common_mistake.why: 'Since childhood' with present simple is a tense error; the present perfect with 'look up to' is natural.

cloze.sentence: Young engineers ____ ____ ____ her for her calm under pressure.

en_def: to disappoint someone by not doing what you promised
hi_nuance: Hindi 'निराश करना'. 'Don't let me down' — very common. Separable. Noun: 'a letdown'.

examples.en: I'm counting on you — don't let me down.
examples.hi: मैं तुम पर भरोसा कर रहा हूँ — मुझे निराश मत करना।

examples.en: The vendor let us down again with a late delivery.
examples.hi: विक्रेता ने देर से डिलीवरी करके हमें फिर निराश किया।

examples.en: She felt let down by her manager.
examples.hi: उसे अपने मैनेजर से निराशा हुई।

examples.en: The software let the team down during the demo.
examples.hi: डेमो के दौरान सॉफ़्टवेयर ने टीम को निराश कर दिया।

examples.en: He has never let me down.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे कभी निराश नहीं किया।

common_mistake.wrong: You made me disappointed by not coming.
common_mistake.right: You let me down by not coming.
common_mistake.why: 'Made me disappointed' is clumsy; 'let me down' is the idiomatic verb.

cloze.sentence: The team worked hard and didn't ____ anyone ____.

en_def: to invent a story or excuse; to become friends again after an argument; to form a whole
hi_nuance: Three meanings. 'Make up an excuse', 'they made up after the fight', 'women make up 40% of the team'. 'Make up for' = compensate.

examples.en: He made up an excuse for being late.
examples.hi: उसने देर से आने का बहाना गढ़ा।

examples.en: They argued but made up the next day.
examples.hi: उनका झगड़ा हुआ लेकिन अगले दिन सुलह हो गई।

examples.en: Contractors make up half of the workforce.
examples.hi: ठेकेदार कार्यबल का आधा हिस्सा हैं।

examples.en: I'll make up for the lost time this weekend.
examples.hi: मैं इस वीकेंड खोए हुए समय की भरपाई करूँगा।

examples.en: Don't make it up — just say you don't know.
examples.hi: मनगढ़ंत बात मत बनाओ — बस कह दो कि तुम्हें नहीं पता।

common_mistake.wrong: He told a lie story about the traffic.
common_mistake.right: He made up a story about the traffic.
common_mistake.why: 'Lie story' is not English; 'make up' is the verb for inventing a false story.

cloze.sentence: I'll work late tomorrow to ____ ____ for leaving early today.

en_def: to start a journey; to cause an alarm or device to activate
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers say 'we started at 6' — 'we set off at 6' is the travel idiom. In security: 'the scan set off the IDS alerts'.

examples.en: We set off at dawn to avoid the traffic.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक से बचने के लिए हम भोर में निकल पड़े।

examples.en: The smoke set off the fire alarm.
examples.hi: धुएँ से फ़ायर अलार्म बज गया।

examples.en: The port scan set off several alerts.
examples.hi: पोर्ट स्कैन से कई अलर्ट सक्रिय हो गए।

examples.en: What time are you setting off tomorrow?
examples.hi: तुम कल कितने बजे निकल रहे हो?

examples.en: His comment set off a long argument.
examples.hi: उसकी टिप्पणी से एक लंबी बहस छिड़ गई।

common_mistake.wrong: We started from home at 5 am for Goa.
common_mistake.right: We set off for Goa at 5 am.
common_mistake.why: 'Started from home' is a Hindi calque ('घर से निकले'); 'set off for' is the travel idiom.

cloze.sentence: Be careful — that motion sensor will ____ ____ the alarm.

en_def: to spend time trying to improve or complete something
hi_def: पर काम करना, सुधारने की कोशिश करना
hi_nuance: 'I'm working on it' = I'm handling it. Also 'work on your accent'. Hindi speakers say 'I am doing that work' — 'I'm working on it' is the idiom.

examples.en: I'm working on the report right now.
examples.hi: मैं अभी रिपोर्ट पर काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: She's working on her pronunciation every day.
examples.hi: वह हर दिन अपने उच्चारण पर काम कर रही है।

examples.en: We're working on a fix for the login bug.
examples.hi: हम लॉगिन बग के समाधान पर काम कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: It's not done yet, but I'm working on it.
examples.hi: अभी पूरा नहीं हुआ, लेकिन मैं इस पर काम कर रहा हूँ।

examples.en: You need to work on your time management.
examples.hi: तुम्हें अपने समय प्रबंधन पर काम करना चाहिए।

common_mistake.wrong: I am doing work on that ticket.
common_mistake.right: I'm working on that ticket.
common_mistake.why: 'Doing work on' is heavy; 'working on' is the natural phrase.

cloze.sentence: I need to ____ ____ my v/w sounds this week.
